text_block_list.text: One day in the academy hallway...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That should be all of it.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув appears to be deep in
thought as she
stares at a pile of
cardboard boxes in the corner
of the
hallway.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: What's with all these cardboard boxes?

text_block_list.text:
Do not even think of approaching me
with such
imprudence. I shall put these
boxes away myself.
Your concern is not
required.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
An accumulation of superfluous notices,
returned
loan umbrellas, and damaged
academy
equipment.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
As part of the student council, I will
re-sort these
items in another room.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
Will you be all right carrying all that by
yourself?

You'd better hurry if you want to get through
all of that.

text_block_list.text:
As part of the student council, I will
re-sort these
items in another room.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list:
Will you be all right carrying all that by
yourself?

You'd better hurry if you want to get through
all of that.

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Are you attempting to express
concern for
me? This poses no challenge
to one who trains on
a daily basis.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув picks up the pile of
cardboard boxes
like a bag of feathers
and walks away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. If I cannot handle this trifling pile
in a
timely manner...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Then I do not deserve to show my face
to others
as the Empress or the vice
president of the school
council.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Enough pointless chatter. I'm sure you
have more
important things to do than
concern yourself with
me. Be off, then.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув picks up the pile of
cardboard boxes
like a bag of feathers
and walks away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It is evident by how steady her steps are
that she
has trained every inch of her
body.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't waste a single movement as
she
carries the large boxes, attesting to
the
thoroughness she applies to
everyday life.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
